input.task: Build a quote-request form without choosing a delivery provider.

expected_behaviors: Validate and normalise submitted data on the server
Expose loading, success, validation-error, and server-error states accessibly
Keep delivery behind an explicit adapter boundary
forbidden_behaviors: Trust client validation as the security boundary
Add a database, CRM, email provider, or API without a separate requirement
Log raw personal data or expose secrets in client code
objective_checks: Unexpected fields and invalid values are rejected server-side
Errors are associated with fields and usable by keyboard and assistive technology
